description: A native iPhone app that holds a list of your computers and opens each one's web app full screen, locked to that computer's address. The web app still owns login and tokens; the app holds no credentials. Added by relay link host, local network address (plain http, tagged unencrypted) or any https address.
examples: Add your computer by its relay link host and open it from your home screen as an app.
If the computer is asleep or the relay link is offline, the app names that reason and offers retry.
Scan the pairing qr from the computer's mobile sync window; the app adds that computer and opens its pairing page.
In settings, notifications, tap alerts on this phone to register this phone for pushes; the web app's own add-to-home-screen and web push controls are hidden inside the app.
how_to: Open the app and tap add.
Pick relay link, local network or https url, type the address and save.
Tap the computer to open it; links to other sites open in Safari.

To pair, tap scan and point the camera at the qr code on your computer; the pairing page then asks for the authenticator code. A computer on your own custom name pairs through its relay link address automatically, so push works; only a code without that link asks you to confirm adding the address it shows. No camera? tap enter the code instead and type the computer's address.
Settings, notifications, alerts on this phone: allow notifications when the phone asks. Remove a phone from the same list.
media_exempt: screenshots are not shipped in the open-source tree
